craft_notes: Sthāyin: who-may-enter (FIRST-VERSE of the batch: plain injunctive catalogue; sets the workmanlike voice — owner verdict required). Rows: row 3 (turned→command). Close: command (ājñā as landing: the Lord's word closes). Rejected: smoothing the catalogue — kept whole (the list IS the verse); 'convert' — kept turned-hither (unmukhī as facing-toward).

lines: For lower-doctrine dwellers, up to gurus even, after dying —
solely by the Lord's raising-power-descent: the final-sacrament initiation;
and for higher-doctrine dwellers who lost observance and skipped expiation — thus the Lord's command.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atha adharaśāsanasthānāṃ gurvantānām api maraṇasamanantaraṃ mṛtoddhāroditaśaktipātayogād eva antyasaṃskārākhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ kuryāt ūrdhvaśāsanasthānām api luptasamayānām akṛtaprāyaścittānām iti parameśvarājñā

reads_against.argmap: Who is initiated after death? → Even the unqualified dead qualify: power-descent alone admits, immediately after death, to the final sacrament.
c1_essence: The dead of any doctrine admitted: immediately after death, solely by raising-power-descent, to the final-sacrament initiation.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with karuṇa undertow (quiescence carrying compassion) (śama with karuṇā (quiescence with compassion))
